claim: A Tamil Guardian report said checkpoints were reinstalled in Pannai, Mukamalai, Mandaithivu and Eluthumadduval in January 2025 after earlier removals following the change of government.
bounded_by: The UK Home Office independently records the report but explicitly states it found no corroborating information for the specific reinstatement event; therefore this remains a single-origin event report, not corroborated fact.
notes: Preserves source-family limitation instead of laundering repetition as corroboration.
